title: Which part of a decode does the fold check verify?
question: Does the source fold proxy compare disjoint held-out complements or overlapping right-hand tails?
reader_question: Can a consistency check leave part of a decoded page unverified?
summary: Six known-key plants show the fold helper checks overlapping tails and omits its final fold. Changing the first 40 comparison indices leaves all measured agreements unchanged.
finding: All six 240-rune source-beam plants recover exactly. Across k=2..6, only k-1 tails are compared; first-fold reference indices are never included. Source-helper reference changes confirm the measured domains; independent encryption and trace recount verify all 30 rows and 90 aggregates.
reader_finding: The helper checks overlapping right tails; it never compares the first fold of reference indices and skips the final fold.
reader_limit: Known-key diagnostic controls; no manuscript key, complete hit decision or original hallucination catch surface is tested.
limitations: One fixed English plaintext window, three key seeds, suppression 0/.83 and exact/keyskip1 only. Reference-change diagnostics keep the ciphertext and key fixed; they are not wrong-key trials or a measured real-candidate false-pass rate. Missing exact source language panel prevents replaying the original R21 catch audit.
next_steps: Recover the exact source language panel before interpreting the complete survivor-selection gate; test any revised fold scheme against separate genuine and hallucination populations.

scope.representation: One source-derived 240-rune English plaintext window; six newly enciphered GP29 known-key plants.
scope.procedure: Execute unchanged source class/helper definitions selected by AST, real source encoder and beam; trace prefix/tail calls, compare diagnostic reference edits, independently recount encryption and agreements.
scope.parameters: Seeds 3301,3302,3303; suppression 0/.83; k2..6; min/mean/frac_pass; beam400 exact/keyskip1; offset0; sign-1; 2000 key symbols.
scope.exclusions: Original hallucination selection, calibrated nine-register adjudication, full hit gate, wrong-key false-pass rates, manuscript search and other fold/proxy implementations.

review.reviewer: Independent encryption reconstruction and traced-domain/agreement recount
